provider.transport_note: For this emulator run, adb reverse and a temporary localhost TCP proxy forwarded the Android loopback port to the authorized PC LM Studio endpoint 192.168.31.169:1234. This is test routing evidence, not a claim of direct LAN discovery.

journey: Android model settings selected the PC qwen3 LM Studio profile and Probe reported protocol response contains content.
Android generated a real draft; Python validation reported the draft as valid after the explicitly shown controlled hybrid skeleton mapping and repairs.
User edited the generated world name (潮汐之门-PC-Q3), revalidated it, and confirmed creation; only then were World, WorldVersion, Hero, Run and RunState created.
The Android gameplay UI applied three Python-planned choices and displayed the bad ending as locked at revision 3.
The UI rollback action restored the state after the second choice; the final screen showed revision 6 with no ending banner, and the state was readable after the rollback chain.
After force-stop and relaunch, the Worlds screen still showed 潮汐之门-PC-Q3 with one playable Run, confirming persisted local recovery.
limits: The proxy was used only to route the emulator to the PC model; Android direct LAN connectivity without a test forwarder remains unverified.
The model-authored mechanics were rejected and replaced by the Python-owned safe hybrid skeleton; arbitrary model rules are not accepted.
This proves Android UI plus embedded local core behavior, but not a packaged Windows journey or direct LAN connectivity without test forwarding.
